How to play

• 3 reels × 3 rows, 5 paylines (3 rows + 2 diagonals).
• Total Bet = bet per line × 5 lines.
• 3 matching symbols on a payline pay the symbol multiplier × TOTAL BET.
• 2 cherries from the left on a payline also pay.
• Tap SPIN again while reels spin to stop them instantly.
• AUTO keeps spinning until you stop it or diamonds run out.
• Win levels (win ÷ total bet): WIN 1×–5× · BIG WIN 5×–10× · SUPER WIN 10×–20× · MEGA WIN 20×–50× · EPIC WIN 50×–100× · SUPER MEGA WIN 100×–200× · JACKPOT WIN 200×–500× · GRAND JACKPOT 500×+.
• Tap the trophy to see the winners ranking.
